substantiveCommits.message: feat: refine foliage silhouette coverage and shadows
qa: define foliage silhouette optics contract
docs: add foliage silhouette lookdev illustration
qa: enforce foliage silhouette optics in formal evidence

objective: Reduce generated-tree card-like leaf silhouettes and keep visible foliage edges coherent with cast dapple shadows without awarding unobserved visual points.

reasoning.observedSourceRisk: The foliage shader rendered the full explicit diamond lamina footprint; the PBR leaf albedo alpha is generated as 1.0 everywhere, so no texture alpha could remove ruler-straight card edges.
reasoning.selectedFix: Use canonical raw leaf UV for a deterministic healthy-margin coverage function, separate from tiled PBR UV, with derivative antialiasing and alpha-to-coverage in the forward pass and the same coverage function in the shadow caster.
reasoning.geometryVsMaterialBoundary: Existing folded lamina geometry remains responsible for size, attachment, orientation and macro curvature. The shader only removes/insets a sub-centimetre-scale healthy biological margin inside the existing leaf footprint.
reasoning.whyPriority: This directly targets Vegetation natural complexity and a visible primitive/card failure mode while also improving dapple-shadow silhouette coherence. It is higher expected visual value than adding another evidence-only contract.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Vegetation/natural complexity 8: direct positive candidate if actual silhouettes stop reading as repeated cards.
Lighting/shadows/reflections 15: secondary positive candidate if leaf and dapple-shadow margins remain coherent.
Temporal/LOD/aliasing 5: uncertain until native temporal evidence confirms alpha-to-coverage does not shimmer.

knownLimitations: The underlying generated leaf topology remains coarse and bounds the maximum possible silhouette quality.
Margin phase varies by leaf cluster rather than by individual leaf inside a cluster.
Actual alpha-to-coverage behavior depends on the Unity formal target MSAA/runtime state.
Shadow-map filtering and grazing subpixel coverage can still shimmer despite source-side derivative AA.
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 Runner/runtime. When available, stop speculative expansion, compile the shader and QA, produce the sealed native 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing packet plus 100% vegetation/tree-shadow crops and temporal/subpixel_grazing, then score/fix actual pixels before any Visual Fidelity award.
